verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical. In both, the 'ALL AGES' pill floats above the headline and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has fallen below the URL, so the reading order is scrambled. The top text stack is jammed together, the RSVP button has the same weight as the FREE ENTRY and TASTINGS pills, and an oversized partner-mark placeholder takes over the bottom. B packs the copy even tighter: the subtitle nearly touches the date and the time line, which leaves A slightly less cramped.
